about: Every contract that crosses an APEX tool boundary. Atrium is the owner of record; the member repo named in 'home' carries the file. A contract change updates this registry in the same change (python -m atrium_check repin). Human-readable view: CONTRACTS_REGISTRY.md.

contracts.name: RulingRecord/1
contracts.revision_note: Breaking change recorded (decision 35 ii = A): Locutus L0.2 on 2026-10-23 made issue_signature, bbox_space and pack_sha256 required and engine_family an enum under the v1 label, before any record was on file. Grandfathered as 1.1; the file and its const stay RulingRecord/1. The next tightening must be a v2 file.

contracts.name: ForgeRequest/1
contracts.note: ForgeRequest/1 and ForgeOutput/1 share one schema file (oneOf).

contracts.name: ForgeOutput/1
contracts.note: ForgeRequest/1 and ForgeOutput/1 share one schema file (oneOf).

contracts.name: ShapeCheckScope/1
contracts.note: Scope schema for a PatternPack/1 artefact of kind shape_check; it validates a sub-object, so it carries no contract const.

contracts.name: PhrasingRuling/1
contracts.note: W-8 phrasing lexicon ruling (Locutus #21); contract name moved to the suite form in Locutus #25.

contracts.name: CorrectionRecord/1
contracts.note: 5b.8 Correction Ledger record (Locutus #32); emitted by Sequoia sequoia/correct/ (Sequoia #53), which vendors the bytes under the same sha256 pin.

contracts.name: TagProposal/1
contracts.note: W-7 manual-tag proposal sibling contract (Locutus fd931cb). The dotted name 'conclave.tag_proposal.v1' is deliberate: under W-7 design §3.5 the record is owned by Conclave and emitted by the Workbench, so it keeps the Conclave form. Any move to the suite form is a W-7 decision, not a registry follow-up.

contracts.name: TagRuling/1
contracts.note: W-7 manual-tag ruling sibling contract (Locutus fd931cb). The dotted name 'conclave.tag_ruling.v1' is deliberate: under W-7 design §3.5 the record is owned by Conclave and emitted by the Workbench, so it keeps the Conclave form. Any move to the suite form is a W-7 decision, not a registry follow-up.

contracts.name: EngineFamilies/1
contracts.note: Data contract, regenerated from the Conclave roster (CL-3 method_family); Conclave ECHO_REGISTRY row (CL-56).

contracts.name: KBInput/1
contracts.note: Inbound edge (SPEC_KB_INPUT). Documents carry no contract field; the identifying field is kb_input_version. Deliberately open (parse_kb_input ignores unknown keys) except the closed context_notes items; four validator rules are not expressible in JSON Schema (Sequoia CONTRACTS.md).
contracts.revision_note: Breaking change recorded (reviewer 3 on Sequoia #56, same precedent as RulingRecord/1 decision 35 ii): on 2026-11-05 Sequoia declared the context_notes block as closed note objects and parse_kb_input began refusing other shapes, under the v1 label. The only writer, Conclave's translator (#2370), already wrote that shape. Grandfathered as 1.1; the file stays kb_input.v1.schema.json and kb_input_version stays 0.1.0. The next tightening must be a v2 file.

contracts.name: ApexAuditRecord/1
contracts.note: Outbound edge (SPEC_INTEGRATION §3, SPEC_REPLAY §5). Documents carry no contract field; identifying field audit_schema_version (const 0.1.0).

contracts.name: MissedRuleFlag/1
contracts.note: Outbound edge to Conclave Review (SPEC_MISSED_RULE section 4, blueprint 5b.3): one JSONL line per missed-rule flag, written by sequoia.missed_rule.write_flags and read by conclave-review import-sequoia-flags (Conclave #2368). The dotted name is the one the file has carried since Sequoia #50. Not expressible in JSON Schema and checked by the consumer: flag_id is the hash of the identity block and kb_sha256 the hash of the KB bytes.

tool_enums.why: Locutus produces Pattern Packs; it is never their consumer.
A query asks about the patterns for a tool that rules on items; the hub only displays and Locutus is the one answering.

replicas.why: Obsidian emits RulingRecord/1 and must not import Locutus at run time, so its tests validate against this pinned replica (tests/fixtures/locutus/PIN.json).
